rule: SkyeOpsConsole, Still2Vid Forge, MyDrive Offline Vault, SkyePics, BrandForge core, Social Batch Factory core, and KeyGate 13 are Free99/no-charge gated apps. Every Paid-Apps platform and every AI/provider-cost lane must stay gated, carry platform_id plus usage_lane, and require paid entitlement, owner approval, or quote before live usage, invoicing, or Stripe SKU rebuild.

metering_contract.paid_platform_default: enabled=false until standalone checkout, owner approval, or explicit bundle entitlement activates the platform usage bucket
metering_contract.rate_limit_rule: Dedicated rate-limit windows use customer_id + api_key_id + platform_id + usage_lane when a SkyePay policy bucket exists; otherwise the global key/customer limit remains the fallback.
metering_contract.cost_rule: usage_events records platform_id and usage_lane so invoices, caps, and operator reports can split usage by platform.
